blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, ILOCOS SUR, Philippines — The La Union Police Provincial Office (LUPPO) asserted on Monday (Nov. 2) that it does not tolerate corruption or the involvement of its personnel in illegal activities, adding that it takes seriously allegations that its officer-in-charge was protecting illegal gambling operations, including “peryahan” activities in some municipalities. In a statement, LUPPO said the allegations deserved proper attention and an objective assessment based on facts and verifiable evidence. It said it was open to investigations by the appropriate authorities, including the 8888 Citizens’ Complaint Center and other government oversight institutions.
